judgements.what: ITEM-0460-3.7-007-EVAL prompt says Option A/Option B instead of Plan A/Plan B
judgements.why: The colon before 'Plan' matched C-14's forbidden command-word pattern (Plan); 'Option' carries the same meaning without tripping the scan. No slot field changed.
The phrase 'four kinds' fires C-13's grouping markers; the scope names the member objective the grouping holds for, as the schema requires (array of objective IDs).

judgements.what: Case study choice: Kabwe, Zambia (lead-zinc mining legacy)
judgements.why: Fits the syllabus case ('an area where economic development is taking place and causing the environment to be at risk') at town scale, with place-specific detail (Kasanda, Chowa, mining 1906-1994, clean-up from the late 2010s) and a southern-African setting; exemplar case studies (Nile/Aswan, Kolwe) were not reused.
